declaration.description: Message registry for the minimal EMPTY business module.

message_contract.context: Legacy int msgId API value carries a 32-bit context rendered as an uppercase X8 token.
message_contract.payload: string[] parsed by the destination handler

LOOPBACK.behavior: Internally publish ECHO with LOOPBACK_TEST using the same context.

endpoint_model.registry: business_commands is the dispatch endpoint registry; each entry declares kind.
endpoint_model.indices: Zero-based comma fields after AT+PUB=: direct command at [1], resource at [1], context at [2], resource command at [3]. Handler-local resource command is args[0].
endpoint_model.compatibility: Keep all existing wire syntax, response/event semantics, registry paths and handler delegate signatures unchanged.

producer.protocol: AT+PUB is an optional producer adapter and is not part of EMPTY business semantics.

validation.handler_rule: Generated RegisterHandlers must register exactly ECHO, INFO and LOOPBACK in the declared order.
validation.inherited_rule: Inherited Level 0 commands must not be regenerated in EmptyModule.cs.
validation.context_rule: Responses and emitted events preserve the incoming non-zero context.
